name: Harvest
description_en:
Harvest organizes client/project/task time and expenses into reports, budgets and invoices. Its website also names Harvest Forecast for forward scheduling; planned capacity is a different record from time actually submitted.

A services team should evaluate the path from recorded work through review and billing, rather than assume an invoice generated from hours is necessarily correct or already paid.
description_zh:
Harvest 按客户/项目/任务组织时间与费用，形成报告、预算及发票。网站另列 Harvest Forecast 用于前向排程，计划容量与实际提交工时是不同记录。

服务团队应评估从记工、审查到计费的路径，不能认为按工时生成发票就必然正确或已经收款。

core_features.explanation_en: Use timers/timesheets to attribute work to the correct project/task.
core_features.explanation_zh: 使用计时器/工时表把工作归入正确项目/任务。

core_features.explanation_en: Review tracked time and expenses before invoice generation and payment collection.
core_features.explanation_zh: 生成发票及收款前审查工时和费用。

en: Create clients, projects, tasks and rates, then record billable and non-billable work plus a reimbursable expense. Compare the report and draft invoice with accepted entries and receipts. A fixed-fee project and an hourly project should not automatically use the same billing interpretation. Test a corrected time entry before relying on exports. No account, invoice or payment was executed.
zh: 创建客户、项目、任务及费率，记录可计费与不可计费工作，以及报销费用。将报告和发票草稿与已接受记录/凭据对照。固定总价与按小时项目不能自动使用同一计费解释。依赖导出前应测试更正记录。本次未执行账户、发票或付款。

sections.title_en: Base seats and extra business objects
sections.title_zh: 基础席位及额外业务对象
sections.en:
The current USD page lists Free for one seat, Teams from $9 per seat monthly equivalent annually or $11 monthly, and Enterprise from $14 annually or $17.50 monthly. It explicitly says additional invoices, projects, clients and tasks can be charged based on use beyond the core base rate. Therefore the seat subtotal is not a complete bill; obtain the applicable usage allowances/rates.

Seats can be added prorata, but removals take effect at renewal rather than reducing the current cycle. The thirty-day trial has no card; absent upgrade the trial account deactivates, while a qualifying Free plan can be selected during trial. Some FAQ text still uses older Pro/Premium naming, so verify actual current entitlements.
sections.zh:
当前 USD 页列 Free 一席位，Teams 年付月均每席位 $9、月付 $11，Enterprise 年付 $14、月付 $17.50。页面明确表示基础费之外，额外发票、项目、客户和任务可按用量收费，因此席位小计不是完整账单，需确认具体额度/费率。

席位可按比例添加，但减少在续期生效，不减少当前周期。三十天试用无需卡，不升级会停用试用账户，符合资格时可在试用中选 Free。部分 FAQ 仍用旧 Pro/Premium 名称，需核实当前实际权益。

sections.title_en: A financial workflow needs a correction owner
sections.title_zh: 财务流程需要明确更正负责人
sections.en:
Prepare permissions, billing methods, opening project balances and accounting mappings. Investigate whether a missing row is unapproved, unbillable or outside a reporting period before reimporting; repeat exports can become duplicate invoices.

Client-service teams are the natural evaluation audience. The managed web/desktop/mobile offering does not establish open-source or self-hosting rights. No approval, processor fee, accounting compatibility, retention/export completeness, software licence or restoration was tested.
sections.zh:
准备权限、计费方式、项目期初余额及财务映射。重新导入前先检查缺失行是否未批准、不可计费或不在报告期，重复导出可能变成重复发票。

客户服务型团队是适合评估的受众。托管网页/桌面/移动方案不证明开源或自托管权。未测试审批、处理商费用、财务兼容性、保留/导出完整性、软件许可或恢复。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)

research_gaps.en: Extra-object allowances/rates, legacy FAQ naming, exact Free limits, tax, payment/integration and restore need account checks.
research_gaps.zh: 额外对象额度/费率、旧 FAQ 命名、具体 Free 限制、税费、付款/集成及恢复需账户核对。
